evidence_snippets: The search tool is the text box at the top of the Code Editor that says 'Search places and datasets...' Type the name of a data product, sensor, or other keyword into the search bar and click the search button to see a list of matching places, raster and table datasets.

Click the Palette radio button and specify a custom palette by adding colors ( add ), removing colors ( remove ) or manually entering a comma separated list of hex strings ( edit ) Click Apply to apply the visualization parameters to the current display.

Click the help button in the upper right of the Code Editor to see links to this Developer's Guide, other help forums, a guided tour of the Code Editor and a list of keyboard shortcuts that help with coding, running code, and displaying data on the Map .
